top_news.title: Compiler-Guided Adaptive Proof Search with Cross-Model Synergy on Context-Dependent Theorem Proving
top_news.dek: A new framework improves Lean 4 theorem proving by using compiler feedback to guide adaptive proof search and cross-model synergy.
top_news.brief: Theorem proving in complex Lean 4 projects often fails due to context-specific dependencies. This framework uses compiler error signals to iteratively refine proofs, employing a search strategy that evaluates the quality of previous attempts to prevent degradation during revision.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing compiler-guided feedback loop in theorem proving

top_news.title: AscendNPU-IR: MLIR for Ascend
top_news.dek: AscendNPU-IR leverages MLIR to provide a specialized intermediate representation for Huawei Ascend NPU hardware.
top_news.brief: The project focuses on optimizing operator compilation for Ascend NPUs. Recent updates include memory planning improvements, specifically preventing the reuse of loop-carried buffers to ensure stability in complex compute graphs.
top_news.image_alt: MLIR architecture diagram for Ascend NPU

top_news.title: Launch HN: OneCLI (YC S26) – OSS sandboxed agent harness for teams
top_news.dek: OneCLI is an open-source credential gateway that prevents secret leakage by injecting API keys into AI agents at runtime.
top_news.brief: OneCLI acts as a secure intermediary between AI agents and external services. Instead of hardcoding credentials into agent configurations, developers store them in a centralized vault. The gateway then transparently injects the necessary keys during execution, ensuring agents never directly access or store sensitive secrets.
top_news.image_alt: OneCLI architecture diagram showing secret injection flow

top_news.title: KnowledgeForge: mining gold from the ITSM ticket graveyard
top_news.dek: KnowledgeForge automates the conversion of resolved ITSM tickets into structured knowledge base articles using Amazon Bedrock and AWS Step Functions.
top_news.brief: KnowledgeForge extracts root causes and resolutions from historical incident tickets to populate and maintain enterprise knowledge bases. The pipeline handles deduplication, quality scoring, and content refinement, addressing the common issue of stale or fragmented documentation in IT support environments.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing an automated pipeline converting ITSM tickets into knowledge base articles.

top_news.title: The Open-Sourcing of DeepSeek Harness Opens the Door to Modular, Unbundled AI Agent Infrastructure
top_news.dek: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepSeek Harness, a modular execution runtime designed for building autonomous AI agents.
top_news.brief: The new runtime features a micro-kernel architecture that supports modular plugins for specific agent functions. It includes an append-only event logging system to track execution history, aiming to provide a more unbundled and flexible infrastructure for agent development.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual architecture diagram of the DeepSeek Harness micro-kernel and plugin system.

primary.title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
primary.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models.
